Class MoleculeSpec

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.api.MoleculeSpec
public final class MoleculeSpec extends Object
A validated molecule definition ready to register.

This stores the definition's ID and JSON, rather than adding it to the game immediately. A definition that copies another molecule is resolved when the registrations are combined.
